name: component-expansion-top-level-instance-and-stream-member-refs-resolve-to-same-variable
source:
COMPONENT Heater(in, out)
  PARAM Q = 1000
  out.mdot = in.mdot
  out.P    = in.P
  out.h    = in.h + Q / in.mdot
  duty     = Q
END
Heater H1(s1, s2, Q=5000)
s1.P = 100000
s1.mdot = 2
H1.in.h = 20000
